content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using [product_name] software version [version_no] and attempting to configure SMTP email, but I keep receiving an error. Can anyone help identify what I might be doing wrong?

It looks like updating the software may solve your issue. I ran a test using [product_name] version [version_no] together with the device firmware [version_no]. When checking the SMTP settings, I got the same error as you. After upgrading to [product_name] version [version_no], the error was resolved. You may need to install the latest service pack or firmware for your device.
Hi, I tried the suggested method of upgrading the hardware, but it reports no issues. I am using the same software version as demonstrated in your video.
I did not say that a firmware update was required. You should update your software from [version_no] to [version_no].
Hello, were you able to solve the issue?
Did you read the comment just above yours?
I was asking another user to find out if the entire configuration and SMTP sending process was fixed.
It seems you’re not interested in my assistance. That’s fine.
Hi, sorry for the delayed reply. I successfully upgraded the software and can now configure SMTP. However, I encountered a new issue with DNS errors and started a new thread for that.
I'm experiencing the same 'DNS error.' I've tried several solutions but nothing has worked so far.

This PLC configuration software has been very difficult to use. The DNS error doesn't appear to be a problem on my end since I've tried multiple laptops and internet connections. There's no DNS issue on my PC. It's been several days and no experienced users have responded with a solution. I found something strange with the message center and M flags for sending emails. When I open my program from the file menu via message settings and event settings, the M flags are visible. But if I access message settings through the main software pane, the flags are missing. It took me days of searching and watching videos without finding any mention of this. I discovered it by accident and am unsure how to describe it. I don't understand why the configuration is set up this way.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced errors while setting up SMTP email in [product_name] software version [version_no], largely due to software-version incompatibility. After upgrading to the recommended software version, the SMTP configuration error was resolved, allowing successful setup. However, the DNS error appeared as a new obstacle, discussed in a separate thread. Users want straightforward SMTP setup and matching compatibility between their software and device firmware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect error-free configuration and use of SMTP email features, with compatible software and firmware. They look for reliable setup processes and clear communication regarding issues and solutions.
